items.title: Trump arrives in China for high-stakes meeting with Xi Jinping
items.description: The leaders of the global superpowers are expected to discuss the war in Iran, tariffs, AI and Taiwan during the two-day visit.

items.title: Court overturns Alex Murdaugh's murder convictions and orders new trial
items.description: The court has ordered a new trial over the June 2021 killings of Paul and Maggie Murdaugh.

items.title: Dozens of dogs rescued and suspect arrested in Uganda after BBC investigation
items.description: A BBC investigation exposed how scammers posted social content of dogs in distress to dupe donors into giving money.

items.title: Woman isolating on British island in South Pacific after hantavirus contact
items.description: The woman who was on a virus-hit ship shows "no signs of illness", the government of Pitcairn Islands, a British Overseas Territory, says.

items.title: What to know as Trump visits Xi in China
items.description: Trump has landed in Beijing for the first visit by a US leader since his own in 2017.

items.title: Philippine Senate in lockdown after gunshots fired
items.description: Police commandos entered the building where a senator wanted by the International Criminal Court had sought refuge.

items.title: Israeli strikes on cars in southern Lebanon kill 12, health ministry says
items.description: Two children are among those reported dead after seven cars were struck in separate attacks south of Beirut.

items.title: Epstein abused me while under house arrest, survivor tells US lawmakers
items.description: Roza was among several victims who gave testimony to Democratic lawmakers on Tuesday.

items.title: Russian drone attacks kill 13 in Ukraine after ceasefire expires
items.description: Attacks are continuing after Ukraine's president warned of "more waves" of Russian strikes throughout Wednesday.

items.title: Shrinking Milka chocolate bar tricked consumers, says German court
items.description: A court in Bremen has found the manufacturer of the classic Alpine Milk chocolate bar guilty of "shrinkflation".

items.title: More than 1,000 passengers held on cruise after gastrointestinal illness outbreak
items.description: The ship, which set sail from Belfast on Friday, is at port in Bordeaux after 49 people fell ill from gastrointestinal illness.

items.title: Climbers clear path to Everest summit past giant chunk of ice
items.description: Nearly 1,000 climbers will attempt to scale the peak in coming weeks and this has raised safety concerns.
